title: Mere bhai Abbas
body:
Haye - 2
Qafela Hogaya Jab Shaam Ke Zindaan Se Riha
Karbala Aane Hi Wali Thi Suno Ahle Azaa
Khud ko Naake Se Girakar Yahi Zainab Ne Kaha
<<MINI>>
Abbas Abbas Bhaiya Abbas
<<DIVIDER>>
Lutgayi Fatema Zehra Ki Kamayi Abbas
Haye Sehroz Ke Pyaase Mere Bhai Abbas - 2
1. Jaan Parde Ki Hifazat Ke Liye Dete The
Naam Sunte Hi Mera Nazre Jhuka Lete The
<<MINI>>
Abbas Abbas Bhaiya Abbas
<<DIVIDER>>
Mai Teri Koi Adaa Bhulna Paayi Abbas
<<MINI>>
Haye Sehroz.....

2. Yaad Baba Ki Jo Tadpati Thi Aksar Mujhko
Dekh Leti Thi Tera Chehra Bulaakar Tujhko
<<MINI>>
Abbas Abbas Bhaiya Abbas
<<DIVIDER>>
Ab Kaha Jaaye Musibat Ki Sataayi Abbas
<<MINI>>
Haye Sehroz.....
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Pushte Sajjad Pe Tehreer Hai Raaho Ke Sitam
Naam Lele Ke Tera Rote Rahe Ahle Haram
Abbas Abbas Bhaiya Abbas Phir Bhi Shikwa Na Koi Hothon Pe Laayi Abbas
<<MINI>>
Haye Sehroz....
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Uske Rukhsaaro Ki Badli Hui Rangat Haaye
Jisne Har Mod Pe Zaalim Se Tamaache Khaaye
<<MINI>>
Abbas Abbas Bhaiya Abbas
<<DIVIDER>>
Har Tamaache Pe Sada Ek Hi Aayi Abbas
<<MINI>>

5. Koi Sunta Na Tha Raaho Me Shikayat Meri
Kaash Tu Dekhta Ek Baar Wo Haalat Meri
<<MINI>>
Abbas Abbas Bhaiya Abbas
<<DIVIDER>>
Khoon Aalud Thi Zainab Ki Kalayi Abbas
<<MINI>>
Haye Sehroz....
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Algaraz Kafela Darbar e Jafa Jab Pahucha
Meri Aawaz Ko Ghairon Ne Suna Wawaila
<<MINI>>
Abbas Abbas Bhaiya Abbas
<<DIVIDER>>
Jurm Kya Tha Jo Saza Maine Ye Paayi Abbas
<<MINI>>
Haye Sehroz....

7. Roklo Akhtar o Irfan e Aza Apna Sukhan
Faisla Kar Chuki Abbas E Dilawar Ki Bahan
<<MINI>>
Abbas Abbas Bhaiya Abbas
<<DIVIDER>>
Tere Tukdo Pe Palengi Ye Khudaai Abbas
<<MINI>>
